topics.overview: Aiden Agent is an AI workspace application for desktop and an interactive CLI, with paired native iOS and Android companions. It supports conversations, configured local or hosted models, workspace tools, optional memory, skills, Web Search, scheduled tasks and supported device tools. Availability depends on platform, setup, permissions and the current chat. Ask for a feature's controls to view its real settings in chat. Experimental or developer-plan features are not promises of installed capabilities.
topics.how-agents-work: Your selected model produces responses and requests tools. Aiden executes admitted tools on the serving host and returns results to the model. Workspace access, app policy and domain permissions determine which effects are allowed. Local models may keep inference on your machine; hosted providers receive the request context. Compaction summarizes older context when needed. Aiden uses Pi as its agent engine. It does not gain access to other chats or devices merely because they appear in the app.
topics.memory: Memory can retain useful facts for future conversations. Global Memory and the selected workspace's Memory gate are separate. Turning Memory off stops future admitted use; it does not delete saved facts or remove context already sent to a model. View Memory controls to see the current gates. Deleting facts is a separate explicit operation.
topics.web-search: Web Search uses the host's configured provider route and credentials. Enabling its switch does not run a search or fetch a model catalog. Setup and actual tool readiness are distinct from the saved enabled preference. Search results are external information, not permission to change app settings.
topics.skills: Skills are instructions that guide the agent for particular tasks. They do not grant permissions or execute app administration by themselves. Aiden includes an immutable aiden-app skill for product questions and controls. The global Skills switch disables skill discovery and use, including the built-in skill. Separately owned product-help functions remain available so you can learn how to restore Skills.
topics.appearance: Appearance changes presentation. Desktop theme, chat width and Reduce Motion belong to the serving desktop app. A paired phone has its own native appearance preferences; a control labeled Paired host changes that host, not the phone. CLI preferences belong to its actual Aiden agent directory and terminal session, not an open desktop window.
topics.privacy: Product help is bundled and read offline. A chat-control click calls Aiden's settings service directly without another inference request. Controls never expose provider keys. Remote controls require a current pairing and applicable grants; a phone is a client of the serving host. Turning features off cannot undo information previously sent to a model. Model catalog and benchmark refreshes remain explicit foreground actions.
topics.setup: Configure providers, authentication, Computer Use and other sensitive capabilities through Aiden's existing trusted Settings and permission flows. Opening setup does not authenticate, fetch catalogs or grant execution automatically. Product controls expose supported preferences only; they do not provide arbitrary shell commands or UI automation. Check the current capability projection before assuming a feature is available.

skill.name: aiden-app
skill.description: Explain Aiden's shipped abilities, agent behavior and privacy, and show or change its supported app controls.
skill.instructions: Use aiden_help for installed product facts and aiden_get_state for current values. For exploratory settings questions, use aiden_show_controls with the relevant topic. For an explicit permitted request, use aiden_set_preference and report only its verified result. Never invent current values, model inventories, permissions or shipped features. Distinguish session, workspace, host and device scope; clarify ambiguity before widening scope. Security setup and required confirmation stay in the host's trusted flows. A skill does not grant authority.
